title: Pro Trek Bluetooth Fishing Watch PRT-B70-1DR
description:
An angler line PRT-B70 from PRO TREK that boasts a 20 bar water resistance. Equipped with optimal functions for fishing through the dedicated “CASIO WATCHES” application via Bluetooth® communication.
Equipped with a fishing timer that displays times ideal for fishing and the likelihood of catching fish, and a function that automatically counts down to the start of fishing time slots. It also displays tidal graphs and sunrise/sunset times for 3,300 points along the world’s major coasts via a link to a dedicated app. It is also equipped with a fishing memo function that records fishing locations in the app based on smartphone location information.
It is also equipped with a quad sensor able to measure number of steps, direction, altitude/barometric pressure, and temperature. Enables on-app confirmation of calories burned while walking. Also allows customized settings, such as a setting to display only necessary functions, on the app. A fine resin case and soft, highly-elastic urethane band are used on the exterior to reduce the burden on the wrist. A wide dial and large, arrow-shaped hands are used to ensure visibility. Standard black is used as the base color to create a sporty design.
